curved180.fov.label: FOV (Horizontal): %s°
curved180.fov.tooltip: Horizontal field of view, 30–360 degrees. Full coverage near the horizon; smoothly narrows toward 100 degrees near vertical. Zoom can narrow it further. Upright panorama blends into camera-relative viewing.
curved180.toggle.tooltip: Turn panorama rendering on or off. When off, Minecraft uses its normal camera and caps the rendered FOV at 110°. Your Curved180 FOV setting is kept.
